Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original representative photograph for a Turkish quality consulting, technical training, certification, and software company's corporate website.
Style/medium: premium professional architectural and editorial photography, convincingly real and optically photographed, crisp contrast and authentic tactile materials.
Color palette: refined deep navy, brushed steel, clean white, natural oak; neutral photographic color balance, no pale teal cast.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2 photograph, 1536 x 1024 pixels or highest appropriate resolution; strong intentional composition and real perspective.
Constraints: an original generic representative scene, not the actual staff or premises of a named company. No readable text, no logos, no watermarks, no actual brands. No handshake cliches, no futuristic CGI, no floating icons or floating data, no oversaturated teal.
Primary request: an expansive light-filled contemporary analytical research laboratory photographed with an architectural perspective and a remarkable sense of depth.
Scene/backdrop: broad glazed windows admit natural directional sunlight; white laboratory architecture, brushed steel instrument forms and glass vessels in the foreground, richly colored deep navy cabinetry concentrated at the right.
Composition/framing: wide establishing view, visually compelling instrument and cabinetry interest toward the right, a calmer left-hand area that can tolerate a website crop; carefully controlled converging lines and realistic perspective.
Lighting/mood: luminous but sculptural daylight, crisp shadows and controlled steel highlights, calm precision and confidence.
Constraints: no people; no centered microscope; no readable labels. Photorealistic credible laboratory equipment, beautifully rendered materials, no fantasy apparatus.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: original representative editorial photograph for the management-system certification service card of a corporate website.
Primary request: a premium, purposeful close-to-medium overhead-oblique photograph of two professionals' hands conducting a structured document review at a warm oak table.
Subject: an understated navy portfolio lies open with neatly aligned matte white quality-review checklist papers. A brushed-metal pen held naturally by one professional thoughtfully indicates a checklist item. The other person's hand rests naturally near the review papers. Only abstract illegible lines and simple small checkboxes appear on the pages. The edge of an unbranded laptop is slightly blurred in the background.
Style/medium: polished and convincingly real professional editorial photography, authentic tactile materials and optically believable depth of field.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 landscape at 1536 x 1024 pixels. Close-to-medium view from overhead at an oblique angle; spacious and carefully composed. Keep the central paper and pen gesture safely within the center for both wide and portrait-ish service-card crops. Show enough surrounding oak table for breathing room. The central gesture and review papers are the focal point.
Lighting/mood: crisp warm window sidelight, controlled contrast, thoughtful focused work, rich navy garments, realistic natural skin tones.
Materials/textures: authentic matte paper, fine oak grain, brushed metal pen, understated navy portfolio, natural anatomically credible hands with realistic finger positions and proportions.
Constraints: generic illustrative scene, not actual BMS employees or premises. No signed certificates, no ribbons, no seals, no accreditation emblems, no authority badges, no claims, no logos, no brands, no readable text, no watermark, no handshake, no staged camera smile. No laboratory instruments or full-room training scene. No CGI, floating graphics, teal color cast, or oversaturated colors.
